tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar can gyi sgo nas byad 'grol bya tshul gsal ba'i sgron me bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ khyod zhabs dran pa'i mod la bgegs dpung tshogs// phye mar 'thag mdzad gzhan gyis mi thub mar// gus pas btud nas byad dang nyer 'tshe kun// zhi byed cho ga'i lag len bri bar bya// 'dir bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar can gyi sgo nas byad dgrol bya bar 'dod pas/ rang gi g.yas phyogs su stegs bu'i steng du stegs khebs sogs bkram pa'i khar 'bru'i tshom bu bkod pa'am/ bum gdan pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings dkar po'i nang du sum gnyis chus gang ba la rdzas nyer lnga btab pa'i steng du dung chos dri bzang gi chus gang ba/ de'i steng du rdo rje la me tog gi phreng ba btags la bzhag mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dkar gtor zlum po pad 'dab bzhis bskor ba rnams bsham/ 'og tu bsgrub bya la dgos pa'i mi du yod kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshon skud sna lnga 'dom re/ sla nga chu thub kyi nang du skyer pa skam po phra mo gshags pa'i hom khung gru gsum brtsigs la/ gtor ma gsum/ theb kyu gsum/ changs bu gsum rnams dang*/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril/ me tog gi snod/ yungs kar/ gu gul rnams sta gon byas la/ rang stan bde ba la 'dug nas thog mar mchod pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai bid+yā āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs kyi byin gyis brlab/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// lan bdun sogs brjod/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags ma gzhan gyis mi thub ma bsgom par bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma gzhan gyis mi thub mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bcom ldan 'das ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥ.ār+ya si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ār+ya si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang zhes sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du yi ge oṃ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi bgegs dang bar chad thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa gcig tu gyur/ de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/

'phags pa mchod/ gzhal du med pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ de thams cad 'phags ma gdugs dkar can gyi skur gyur/ khyad par du 'jigs par byed pa'i gdon dang*/ mdangs 'phrog par byed pa'i gdon dang*/ byad dang*/ rbod gtong thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir zlog pa chen mo sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar ba/ dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo/ rtsa zhal nyis brgya zhi ba dang snying rje'i zhal dkar po/ g.yas zhal nyis brgya sgeg pa dang dpa' ba'i zhal ser po/ rgyab zhal nyis brgya dgod pa dang drag shul can gyi zhal dmar po/ g.yon zhal nyis brgya rngam pa dang nyams sna tshogs pa'i zhal ljang gu/ steng zhal nyis brgya mi sdug pa dang 'jigs su rung ba'i zhal sngon po/ zhal re re la nyams sna tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal la la bzhad pa/ la la mche ba gtsigs pa/ la la gdangs pa/ la la ljags 'dril zhing ha ha zhes drag tu bzhad pa/ spyan stong mnga' ba chen mo/ phyag g.yas dang pos 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i skyabs sbyin/ g.yas 'og ma rnams na 'khor lo dgu bcu go dgu/ rdo rje brgya/ rin po che brgya/ pad+ma brgya/ sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar ba brgya bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos mda' dang bcas pa'i gdugs dkar po rin po che'i tog gis spras pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi 'og ma rnams na mda' gzhu dgu bcu go dgu/ gzhu brgya/ lcags kyu brgya/ zhags pa brgya/ ral gri 'bar ba brgya 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas lnga brgya bskum zhing*/ g.yon lnga brgya brkyangs pas 'jigs par byed pa'i gdon thams cad dang*/ mdangs 'phrog par byed pa'i gdon thams cad dang*/ ma rungs pa'i gdon thams cad mnan pa/ sku la rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos bzang po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ smad g.yogs bsnams pa/ sku'i cha shas thams cad la zur gyis blta ba dang*/

rnam par bgrad pa dang*/ glog ltar 'gyu ba la sogs pa spyan bye ba brgya stong phrag mang pos ma rungs pa 'jigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ spyi bo'i gtsug na mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags su khro bo'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa me 'od rab tu 'bar bas mtshan pa/ 'phags pa thams cad la mchod pa dang*/ duḥkha can rnams la skyabs sbyin pa dang*/ ma rungs pa rnams zil gyis gnon pa ste/ 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba'i dbus na gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'o// de'i thugs kar pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gzhan gyis mi thub ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' oṃ yig dkar po dang bcas pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i stod du oṃ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ abhi ṣiñca tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// zhes pa nas shri ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin la dbang bar byas/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs thams cad kyi bdag po rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/

oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ bde gshegs thugs rje'i gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing*// bde 'byung bstan la gnod byed phyir bzlog nas// bde legs 'bras bu nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i// bde mchog gdugs dkar can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ rang gi thugs ka'i gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i thugs kar oṃ dkar po'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ las bzhi'i phrin las thogs med du 'grub par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ shel dang bo dhi tsi la sogs pa'i phreng ba 'dzin pas/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bi shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ bai re bai re/ badz+ra dha ra ṇi/ bhan+dha bhan+dha badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas mthar gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol// bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas bum bskyed ni bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul ba bcings pa/ oṃ kalpa bri k+ṣa ya swā hā/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ oṃ tāp+te tāp+te ma hā tāp+te swā hā/ lha'i chu bo gaṅgā'i chus gang ba/ de'i dbus su seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du yi ge oṃ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi bgegs dang bar chad thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa gcig tu gyur/

de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ gzhal du med pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ de thams cad 'phags ma gdugs dkar can gyi skur gyur/ khyad par du 'jigs par byed pa'i gdon dang*/ mdangs 'phrog par byed pa'i gdon dang*/ byad dang*/ rbod gtong thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir zlog pa chen mo sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar ba/ dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo/ rtsa zhal nyis brgya zhi ba dang snying rje'i zhal dkar po/ g.yas zhal nyis brgya sgeg pa dang dpa' ba'i zhal ser po/ rgyab zhal nyis brgya dgod pa dang drag shul can gyi zhal dmar po/ g.yon zhal nyis brgya rngam pa dang nyams sna tshogs pa'i zhal ljang gu/ steng zhal nyis brgya mi sdug pa dang 'jigs su rung ba'i zhal sngon po/ zhal re re la nyams sna tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal la la bzhad pa/ la la mche ba gtsigs pa/ la la gdangs pa/ la la ljags 'dril zhing ha ha zhes drag tu bzhad pa/ spyan stong mnga' ba chen mo/ phyag g.yas dang pos 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i skyabs sbyin/ g.yas 'og ma rnams na 'khor lo dgu bcu go dgu/ rdo rje brgya/ rin po che brgya/ pad+ma brgya/ sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar ba brgya bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos mda' dang bcas pa'i gdugs dkar po rin po che'i tog gis spras pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi 'og ma rnams na mda' gzhu dgu bcu go dgu/ gzhu brgya/ lcags kyu brgya/ zhags pa brgya/ ral gri 'bar ba brgya 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas lnga brgya bskum zhing*/ g.yon lnga brgya brkyangs pas 'jigs par byed pa'i gdon thams cad dang*/ mdangs 'phrog par byed pa'i gdon thams cad dang*/ ma rungs pa'i gdon thams cad mnan pa/ sku la rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos bzang po'i stod g.yogs dang*/

smad g.yogs bsnams pa/ sku'i cha shas thams cad la zur gyis blta ba dang*/ rnam par bgrad pa dang*/ glog ltar 'gyu ba la sogs pa spyan bye ba brgya stong phrag mang pos ma rungs pa 'jigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ spyi bo'i gtsug na mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags su khro bo'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa me 'od rab tu 'bar bas mtshan pa/ 'phags pa thams cad la mchod pa dang*/ duḥkha can rnams la skyabs sbyin pa dang*/ ma rungs pa rnams zil gyis gnon pa ste/ 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba'i dbus na gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'o// de'i thugs kar pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gzhan gyis mi thub ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbu na bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' oṃ yig dkar po dang bcas pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i stod du oṃ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma la sangs rgyas dang bya chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// zhes pa nas shri ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin la dbang bar byas/

chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs thams cad kyi bdag po rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ de nas oṃ ār+ya si tā ta ba tre sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ nas shab+da'i bar 'don pa bsgyur bas mchod/ bde gshegs thugs rje'i gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing*// bde 'byung bstan la gnod byed phyir bzlog nas// bde legs 'bras bu nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i// bde mchog gdugs dkar can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song bas bum nang gi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces brjod la bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ gong ltar mchod cing bstod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod yon phul bas bum nang gi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ de nas gtor ma chu gtsang gis sbyang*/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drang*/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ oṃ ār+ya sī tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ bum bskyed ltar mchod cing bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i lha tshogs rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/

mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ badz+ra muḥye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam pa rnams slob dpon gyi bya ba'o// de nas sbyin bdag sogs mdun du bos la sngar gyi tshon skud la lag len ltar mdud pa btab pa bsgrub bya'i ske la bskon/ de nas lag pa gnyis dang rkang pa gnyis kyi srin lag la'ang bskon/ sbyong chas mdun du bshams pa chus bran la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa -i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇa -i daṃ ba liṃ ta swā hā/ zhes gtor ma lan gsum gyis bskor ba zhi bas sbyong ba dang*/ ting lo changs bu dang bcas pas bskor ba dang bstun/ sum+bha lan gsum gyis zhi drag phyed mas sbyong ba dang*/ deng 'dir rdo rje slob ma'am sbyin pa'i bdag po 'di rnams gyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad gtor ma lam rngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ changs bu lam brgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig bdag nyid lha mor gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa oṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms// dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can// log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba// rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal// log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// oṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra e h+ya his spyan drangs/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/

gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ hūm̐/ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las// 'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spang zhing*// thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa// khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can// gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras// ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod// lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing*// bsdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams// nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa// sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod// bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// dpa' bo stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs// nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis// bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs// rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrogs// khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin cing hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du'ang bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar mo can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa bcu/ gdung bdun/ legs ldan mched gsum 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis deng 'dir rdo rje'i slob ma'am sbyin pa'i bdag po 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyong ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas des mgu bar gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig

gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag thams cad la dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyod rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro// sum+bha drag tu bzlas pa lan gsum gyis drag pos sbyong ba'o// de nas byad 'gro la bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la bcings pa'i zhags pa de nyid lus ngag yid gsum la gnod par byed pa'i byad kha rbod gtong mnan gtad gzir gsum la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo zhags pa nag po re rer gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das mar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'od zer gyi sna la khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas nad gdon sdig sgrib byad kha rbod gtong mnan gtad gzir gsum la sogs pa thams cad kyi snying ga nas lcags kyus bzung*/ mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings/ yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la bcings pa'i zhags pa nag po de nyid la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rdor dril dang bcas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du'ang bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar mo can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa bcu/ gdung bdun/ legs ldan mched gsum 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis deng 'dir rdo rje slob ma'am sbyin pa'i bdag po 'di rnams la gnod par byed pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib byad kha rbod gtong mnan gtad gzir gsum la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad lus la bcings pa'i zhags pa nag po 'di nyid la sib sib thim par gyur cig

oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la bcings pa'i zhags pa nag po de nyid nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon bcom ldan 'das mar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi nang nas mar song bas/ lus kyi nang na gnas pa'i bar chad thams cad kyang phyir drangs nas so so'i lus la bcings pa'i zhags pa nag po de nyid la thim par gyur/ de lta bu'i zhags pa slob dpon bcom ldan 'das mar gsal bas me dang chur ngar blud ma'i ral gris dum bur gtubs pas gnod byed gdon bgegs byad phur rbod gtong thams cad tshar gcod pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la ral gri me dang chus ngar blud pas lag len ltar gcad cing*/ ngag tu/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pas byas pa'i rigs sngags thams cad gcad do// kun tu rgyus byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro mas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// tshangs pas byas pa'i rigs sngags thams cad gcad do// dbang phyug chen pos byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// sred med kyi bus byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad do// nam mkha' lding dang lha chen po dang nag po chen pos byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// ma mo'i tshogs kyis byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// mi'i thod pa can gyis byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// srung bar byed pa dang sbrang rtsir byed pa dang don kun grub pas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// sring mo bzhis byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// bhṛṅgi ri ṭi dang dga' byed dbang phyug dang tshogs kyi bdag po dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// dge sbyong gcer bus byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// dge sbyong mgo reg gis byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// dgra bcom pas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// 'dod chags dang bral bas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// lag na rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// pho nya dang pho nya mos byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// drang srong gi tshogs kyis byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// mi phan par 'dod pas byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// zhes dum bur gtub/

de nas spro na shog bur ling gzugs dod par bris pa mdun du bzhag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du'ang bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar mo can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa bcu/ gdung bdun/ legs ldan mched gsum 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod par byed pa'i byad kha rbod gtong dang bcas pa thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi liṅga 'di la khug cig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥlan gsum/ phur bu gzhan gyis mi thub ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i skur gyur par bsam/ de lta bu'i phur bu lag pas bsgril la liṅgar gdab cing*/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad dang mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// tho bas brdung ngo*// phyag rgyas mnan no// de bzhin du/ kun tu rgyus byas pa'i sogs nas/ mi phan par 'dod pas byas pa'i bar re re bzhin gyi mthar/ rig sngags thams cad gcad do// phur bus gdab bo// tho bas brdung ngo*// phyag rgyas mnan no// zhes sbyar/ de nas gong gi tshon skud kyi dum bu dang ling ro yod na de dang bcas mdun du bsham/ sngar gyi sla nga'i hom la me sbar/ bum chu gtor/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po rgya tshad yongs su ma chad pa/

nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis gang ba ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa/ de'i dbus su seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri dang pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du zhes pa nas rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan ces pa'i bar gyis lha bskyed pa dang*/ mchod bstod bcas bum bskyed ltar bya/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku las ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas bsgrub bya'i nad gdon sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen bar chad byad kha rbod gtong thams cad lhag med du bsregs par gyur ces brjod cing bsams la/ spos dang me tog yungs kar dang bcas pa dang*/ tshon skud liṅga dang bcas pa bsgrub bya la bskor zhing*/ oṃ.a si tā na lārka pra bhā spu ṭa pi ka si tā ta pa tre/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ khā da khā da/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ dha ra dha ra/ bi dha ra bi dha ra/ ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha/ bhin+dha bhin+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ he he phaṭa/ ho ho phaṭa/ a mo gha ya phaṭa/ a pra ti ha tā ya phaṭa/ ba ra drā ya phaṭa/ ba ra pra dā ya phaṭa/ pra t+yaṃ gi rā ye phaṭa/

bkru ba sogs kyi mthar yang sngags 'di ltar sbyar ba sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros kyi gsung rgyun las 'byung ngo*// zhes pa'i sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar me nang du phul la/ re re'i mthar rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod par byed pa'i bar chad gdon bgegs byed byur mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod/ slar yang mchod bstod gong ltar bya/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥthab kyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod/ de nas bum chus dkon mchog gi rten la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang sogs kyis sku khrus gsol/ de dag sku la sogs kyis sku phyi nas/ slar yang chu de bum par blugs la/ khyed rang rnams dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bum pa'i nang du bcom ldan 'das ma bzhugs pa'i sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad bkrus pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags kyi sham du/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du/ rims nyin gcig pa dang*/ gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa dang*/ rims mi bzad pa rnams dang*/ 'byung po'i rims rnams dang*/ rims kyi gnod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ rlung las gyur pa dang*/ mkhris pa las gyur pa dang*/ bad kan las gyur pa dang*/ ldan pa las gyur pa dang*/ 'dus pa las gyur pa la sogs pa'i nad thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/

lha'i gdon dang*/ lha ma yin gyi gdon dang*/ rlung lha'i gdon la sogs pa'i gdon thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zas su mdangs 'phrog pa dang*/ gzi byin 'phrog pa dang*/ zas su mngal za ba la sogs pa'i bgegs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ dug gi 'jigs pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ mtshon gyi 'jigs pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swa hā/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ dgra'i 'jigs pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba la sogs pa gnod byed bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyog thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de nas byab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das mar gsal ba'i phyag gi rma bya'i sgro'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad rdo khab len gyis khab len pa'am/ shel sbur len gyis sbur len pa ltar tsen gyis blangs te phyi'i rgya mtsho chen por dor ba'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ khar bum chu 'dzin du bcug kha rgyan gyis byab pa'i tshul byas la sngags kyi mthar/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad a pa nā ya swā hā/ zhes pa nas/ phyogs thams cad a pa nā ya swā hā'i bar sngar gyi rigs 'gres sbyar/ mthar kha'i chu sla nga'i nang du pho/ de nas chu des bsgrub bya la bskor nas sbyin sreg gi thal ba'i nang du blugs/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du'ang bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar mo can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/

bde bar gshegs pa bcu/ gdung bdun/ legs ldan mched gsum 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis deng 'dir rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la gnod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig ces rol mo drag po bya zhing skyel du gtong*/ de nas dril bu gsil zhing me tog gtor ba dang bcas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal// chos ni chos ma yin las rgyal// dge 'dun mu stegs rnams las rgyal// dbang po lha min rnams las rgyal// zla ba lha min rnams las rgyal// nam mkha' lding ni rgya mtsho las// me ni shing rnams kun las rgyal// chu ni me las rgyal bar gyur// rlung ni sprin las rab tu rgyal// rdo rje yis ni rin chen phug /lha rnams bden par rab tu gnas// sa yang bden par gnas pa lags// sangs rgyas dang ni chos kyang bden// bden pa rgyal gyur rdzun ma lags// dza ya dza ya bi dza ya bi dza ya/ zhes brjod/ de nas gdugs dkar gyi 'khor lo che chung gang rung yod na lte ba chings lag len ltar byas pa gdags shing*/ med kyang gtso mo'i sngags kyi mthar/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥ rims nyin gcig pa la sogs pa nas/ shān+tiṃ gi gnas su rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥbatags pas bsrung*/ rdo rje mgo bor bzhag rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// bcom ldan rig pa'i rgyal mo'i mthu stobs kyis// 'gro ba 'di dag bdag gis bsrungs zin gyis// 'di la sus kyang gnod par ma byed cig /ces dang*/ che ba'i che mchog lta bu mdo rgyud las byung ba'i bkra shis ci rigs pa byas la bsgrub bya rnams rang gnas su btang*/ mdun bskyed bum lha gshegs gsol tshar bas mchod bstod sogs rjes chog mi dgos/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/

mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po zhes gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /gtsug tor gdugs dkar 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs bsngo smon dang*/ bkra shis ji ltar rigs pa brjod la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// gzhan las phul byung gdugs dkar lha mo la// brten nas byad kha rbod gtong zlog pa'i thabs// ngag 'don bklags chog tshul du bkod pa'i dges// 'gro 'di'i nad gdon ma lus zhi gyur cig /ces bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar can gyi sgo nas byad 'grol ba'i cho ga gsal ba'i sgron me 'di'ang*/ gong dkar dkon gnyer grwa tshang gi rdo rje slob dpon blo bzang rin chen gyi gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ ris su ma chad pa'i grub mtha' la blo gros dkar ba shākya'i btsun pa lhun grub kyis dben gnas smon dga' bsam gtan gling gi rang gi bsam gtan khang bur sug ris su btab pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
